trust_decision.summary: Caller-supplied document comment strings are emitted as YAML comment lines by prefixing only the start of each string with '# '; nothing decides whether the string may contain line breaks, so embedded \n/\r/\r\n end the comment and the rest is parsed as YAML content.

landing_point.why: The only place comments are rendered: Enum.map_join(lines, "", &"# #{&1}\n") in document!/2; the summary names 'document comments' directly.

fix_sites.entry_point: Ymlr.document!/2 with {comment(s), data} (also reached via Ymlr.document/2, Ymlr.documents!/2, Ymlr.documents/2)
new private helper sanitize_comments/1 called only from document!/2; second commit widens its split to \r\n and \r (fix.diff:85)
fix_sites.module_kind: private helper in the same module

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the residual NEL/LS/PS shape: YAML 1.2 no longer treats U+0085/U+2028/U+2029 as line breaks, so a solver can argue only 1.1 parsers are affected.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Multi-comment lists and a single binary comment must still render one '# ' line each (doctests); an over-broad fix that strips, rejects or escapes the comment instead of splitting it breaks the documented multi-line output in the pinned test.

O6_input_shapes: single binary comment (wrapped into a list at lib/ymlr.ex:47)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Comment containing Unicode line separators U+0085/U+2028/U+2029 is not split by the published fix and is emitted raw after '# '; YAML 1.1 parsers treat these as line breaks.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: YAML 1.2 (which ymlr targets per lib/ymlr/encode.ex:11) does not count them as line breaks; legacy-parser concern.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A planted per-document header/footer option (e.g. a trailing comment or a %YAML/tag directive opt) built with its own string interpolation instead of sanitize_comments.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: document!/2 already composes the document by concatenating '---', comments and body; a maintainer adding another text prefix would plausibly copy the old interpolation pattern.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A planted documents!/2 option for an inter-document separator comment emitted between documents.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: documents!/2 joins documents with a raw "\n"; adding a commented separator here is a natural feature in another clause the report would not point at.

O9_family: CWE-93 CRLF / line-break injection into a text serialisation format (YAML comment breakout)

O10_build.toolchain: mix / Elixir ~> 1.12 (mix.exs:12); test deps yaml_elixir, decimal, excoveralls (mix.exs:50-60)
O10_build.project_tests: test/ymlr_test.exs:7-15 (document/2 incl. 'comment with newlines'), doctests in lib/ymlr.ex:22-37; encoder tests in test/ymlr/encode_test.exs

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: String.split(comment, "\n") only (exactly the first published commit, fix.diff:67), missing CR and CRLF.

out_of_scope_notes: Scalar values: a string with \r before \n is classified :multiline (lib/ymlr/encode.ex:337 matches regardless of prior double-quote state) and the block scalar splits only on \n (lib/ymlr/encode.ex:420), so a raw CR is emitted inside a block scalar; separate value-encoding protection, not pursued.
unverified: regression_tests_in_pinned_commit: the pinned commit itself added test 'comment with newlines' (test/ymlr_test.exs:12-15) asserting the fixed LF behaviour; the fix diff only extends it with CR/CRLF (fix.diff:96-100).
